scope: Read-only byte comparisons of listed worktree source files to the specified commits; not an integrated-tree source binding, compilation result, hosted CI acceptance, or independent human review.

algorithm.source_filter: Decode NUL-separated tracked paths as UTF-8; keep paths whose pathlib.Path.suffix belongs to the listed suffixes; sort paths lexicographically.
algorithm.comparison: Compare raw bytes returned by git show with pathlib.Path.read_bytes from a regular, non-symlink worktree file; no newline, encoding, whitespace, or proof normalization.
algorithm.hash: SHA-256 of exact raw file bytes.
algorithm.module_inventory: Read the existing module-list.txt, compare its bytes to the PR parent, and map each line M to proof/PscVerif/ plus M with dots replaced by slashes plus .lean; compare all resulting files to the PR parent.
algorithm.golden_additions: Compare the explicitly listed GoldenEndpoint source and note to the main reference commit.
algorithm.read_stability: Re-read every distinct compared worktree file after all comparisons and require byte identity to its initially observed bytes; this does not bind unlisted files.
algorithm.source_manifest_sha256_serialization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON mapping each compared source path to its worktree SHA-256, with sorted keys, separators comma and colon without spaces, ensure_ascii=False, and no trailing newline.
